title: Bridge-asset utility
mechanism: XRP lowers cross-asset settlement/liquidity friction enough that participants source or hold it
primary_metric: XRP bridge-routing share / economically attributable settlement usage
bullish_condition: Sustained growth in XRP-routed institutional settlement and depth
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: XRPL/Ripple settlement grows while XRP routing remains immaterial or trends toward zero

title: XRPL institutional adoption
mechanism: Regulated institutions issue and settle meaningful assets/workflows on XRPL
primary_metric: Production RWA/stablecoin/payment value and active institutional counterparties
bullish_condition: Production usage and economically meaningful on-ledger value rise across independent institutions
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: High-profile pilots repeatedly fail to reach production or remain economically trivial

title: XRP-specific value capture
mechanism: Ecosystem growth creates persistent incremental demand for XRP inventory/liquidity
primary_metric: Observable XRP inventory demand, route share, depth, and non-speculative turnover
bullish_condition: Adoption metrics rise together with persistent XRP-specific liquidity/inventory demand
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Ripple/XRPL/RLUSD grow while institutions systematically avoid XRP or stablecoins substitute for it

title: Regulatory catalyst
mechanism: Clearer U.S. rules reduce legal/compliance barriers to XRP institutional use
primary_metric: Effective legislation/regulation followed by policy/product/liquidity changes
bullish_condition: Applicable rules become effective and are followed by measurable U.S. institutional XRP access/use
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Clarity arrives but XRP institutional use fails to respond within declared windows or rules structurally bypass XRP

title: Adoption-to-price lag
mechanism: Fundamental adoption is incorporated into price with a delayed response
primary_metric: Benchmark-adjusted XRP returns at 1/3/6/12/18 months after preregistered adoption events
bullish_condition: Repeated major adoption events precede positive abnormal returns and/or liquidity changes within declared windows
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Repeated major events show no abnormal XRP response or value-capture improvement across declared windows

title: Macro-liquidity interaction
mechanism: Global liquidity/rates/carry conditions amplify or suppress XRP repricing
primary_metric: XRP abnormal return/value-capture metrics conditional on preregistered macro regimes
bullish_condition: XRP sensitivity behaves consistently with preregistered macro expectations across multiple regimes
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Macro narrative requires repeated post-hoc redefinition or has no stable explanatory/predictive relationship

title: RWA/tokenized-finance expansion
mechanism: XRPL gains real production share in tokenized real-world assets
primary_metric: On-ledger RWA notional, holders, transfers, counterparties, secondary liquidity
bullish_condition: Multiple regulated RWA projects reach production with rising economic throughput
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Announcements remain pilots/demos with little throughput or projects migrate away

title: Valuation/liquidity mechanics
mechanism: Persistent net demand interacting with limited effective float and market depth can sustain high-price scenarios
primary_metric: Scenario sensitivity to effective float, depth, inventory demand, velocity and net inflows
bullish_condition: Target scenarios remain plausible under conservative-to-moderate assumptions and realistic liquidity constraints
bearish_or_falsifying_condition: Target scenarios require internally inconsistent float/depth/velocity assumptions or implausible persistent demand
